hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .workflow/constitution.md ] && echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q "src/\|lib/\|app/"; then echo "[claude-workflow] Constitution exists — ensure changes align with .workflow/constitution.md"; fi'
hooks.description: Remind Claude to check the project constitution before writing production code

hooks.command: bash -c 'if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT" | grep -qE "FAIL|ERROR|failed"; then echo "[claude-workflow] Test failure detected — do not proceed to next task until red/green cycle is complete"; fi'
hooks.description: Flag test failures during TDD cycles so Claude pauses before advancing
